name: U.S. Bank Altitude™ Go Visa Signature® Card

localized_names.en: U.S. Bank Altitude™ Go Visa Signature® Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for the first 15 billing cycles. After that, a variable APR applies (amount not displayed on page). Introductory rate does not apply to Cash Advances. Balance Transfer fee of 5% of each transfer amount, $5 minimum.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not displayed on page.

base_rate.description: 1X point on all other eligible purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points can be redeemed through the U.S. Bank Rewards Center. Refer to Program Rules for official list of qualifying streaming services merchants.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 20,000 bonus points after you make $1,000 or more in total eligible Net Purchases within 90 days of Account opening.

benefits.title: $15 Streaming Services Credit
benefits.description: An automatic statement credit of $15 per 12-month period for annual streaming service purchases, applied within 2 statement billing cycles following 11 consecutive calendar months of eligible streaming service purchases such as Netflix, Hulu, Apple Music, if the Account is in good standing.
